name: Pre-Sleep Heat
title: Use heat before bed.
subtitle: Sleep Routine
rationale: Warming the body before bed accelerates the temperature drop that initiates sleep.

evidence.summary: Peer-reviewed sleep research supports warm water-based passive heating before bed as a practical sleep lever.

indications: Sleep onset is slow despite a good shutdown routine.
Evening tension or cold extremities delay sleep.
A bath, hot shower, or sauna is practically available.
avoidWhen: Pregnancy, cardiovascular instability, heat intolerance, or sauna contraindication.
